summary: A Webflow page on the Cinetype foundry site that reads as an illustrated essay: a narrow white text column about Fabbrica's architectural proportions, technical shapes and technical-drawing warmth, interleaved with dark full-width figure images (annotated letters, archival and product photos, a DIN comparison slider, Default vs Sharp corners, stylistic-set slides, feature catalogue). Every specimen is a static image or video; there is no tester, and buying links out to the distributor.

instances.look: White foundry header: 'CINETYPE' in widely tracked caps at the left, small links 'Typefaces · Custom ▾ · Writing · About · Licensing' at the right; a fixed slate cookie banner ('This website uses cookies… Got it!') covers the bottom of every screen in the capture

Small heading 'Fabbrica' and a three-line description, with a thin outlined box button 'Buy Fabbrica / or Get Trial fonts' on the right; the same button returns after 'Why Fabbrica?' near the end (seen on mobile, not cut as a desktop block)
instances.ux: Links to the distributor C-A-S-T, where purchase and trials happen
instances.learn: One two-line outlined button near the title and again after the conclusion is enough for an essay-style page
